records.name: Moli by Lexmount
records.tagline: The fastest headless browser for agents and harnesses
records.description: Moli by Lexmount is our browser engine built from scratch for AI agents. It starts faster and uses less memory than Chrome. Use Moli through Lexmount Browser, our cloud browser platform. Run multiple isolated browser sessions with proxy support while we handle the infrastructure. Let your agents browse, fill out forms, and extract data. Try it in our Playground or connect through our SDK.

records.name: Papermark Data Rooms
records.tagline: Secure data rooms your AI agents can run. Live in < 60 sec.
records.description: Data Rooms 2.0: launch a secure data room in under 60 seconds. Encrypted, fully certified, with file permissions, built-in Q&A, a full audit log and analytics. White-label it on your domain, or let agents run it via API, CLI and MCP.

records.name: Llama Windows
records.tagline: One local AI server for all your Windows apps
records.description: Llama Windows brings llama.cpp to the Windows 11 system tray. Download open models from Hugging Face in one click, chat via Alt+Space, and let coding agents, editors and scripts share a local OpenAI-compatible API and model cache. Free and open source.

records.name: AgentGrid.io
records.tagline: Shared workspace for humans and agents
records.description: Built for Grok Bot, Muse AI, Instinct, Hermes, Claude, GPT, OpenClaw, Cursor, Codex, all agents are welcome. Work on the same live artifacts. Docs, reports, slides, apps, and designs, with shared context, controlled access, and full version history.

records.name: Clips by Plastic
records.tagline: Lyric video ads for every part of your song, on the beat
records.description: Drop in a finished song and your own footage or photos. Clips finds the tempo and every part (verses, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge) and makes a vertical lyric video for each one, cut on the beat, with the words synced. Pick a layout and one of 54 effects, then export every part on every backdrop at once, named and ready for Ads Manager. Run them all for a week and put your budget behind the part that wins. Works offline. Free to try, then $99 once.

records.name: pawl
records.tagline: a tiny mac focus timer you start by pulling a paw
records.description: start a focus timer by pulling a cat paw, it lives in your mac menu bar or you can pin it like a mini timer! it has adjustable focus and break sessions, eight cat paws, themes, and a quiet heads-up before your timer ends. made for macos 14+. $9.99 once, with no subscription.

records.name: MRRaudit
records.tagline: Understand why your MRR differs and get a number you trust
records.description: MRRaudit explains why your MRR numbers differ so you can get to a figure you trust. Compare Stripe and ChartMogul customer by customer, trace discrepancies to invoices and subscription events, and choose how billing events affect MRR. Built by the ChartMogul team, who've obsessed over SaaS metrics since 2014 and helped thousands of SaaS businesses investigate these differences by hand through calls and support tickets. Read-only access. No ChartMogul account required.

records.name: Badgey
records.tagline: Your iPhone becomes a name badge that faces the room
records.description: Badgey turns your iPhone into a name badge. On a lanyard, it turns to face the people you meet and swings as you move. In a chest pocket, it shrinks so your name shows above the edge. Several badges, a QR code for your link, five designs.

records.name: How It Spread
records.tagline: See how anything went viral, from the first post
records.description: A library of 1,600+ viral films, products, memes and campaigns.

records.name: Yourcast 2.0
records.tagline: AI summaries with tap-to-jump timestamps, right in Telegram
records.description: Yourcast is a Telegram bot for podcasts: search a show, tap to subscribe, and new episodes arrive as audio right in your chat. 2.0 adds AI summaries with timestamps you can tap to jump in the audio, questions about any episode, feeds that repair themselves, files up to 2 GB, OPML import and payments in Telegram Stars. Free: 10 episodes a week on demand. Open source (GPL v3). In English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Hebrew.

records.name: Openstatus Incident Management
records.tagline: Incident management for small teams
records.description: Open source incident management next to your monitors and status page. Declare from Slack, get a channel per incident, keep a timeline and draft the postmortem.

records.name: git-flow-next
records.tagline: Your favorite Git workflow. Reimagined.
records.description: A flexible, modern approach to the popular git-flow branching model. Download the CLI tool to get started with a better Git workflow: brew install git-flow-next

records.name: Specsight
records.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
records.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

records.name: Scale Local
records.tagline: Shop Local. Live Better.
records.description: Scale Local is a hyperlocal shopping app that helps you order food, groceries, and daily essentials from nearby stores. Browse products from local businesses, place orders for delivery or pickup, and manage your shopping in one app. Features: 🛒 Grocery Shopping Browse grocery products including fruits, vegetables, dairy, beverages, snacks, household items, and more. 🍔 Food Ordering Order meals from nearby restaurants and food outlets.

records.name: Eleve: Athlete Progress
records.tagline: AI-powered progress tracking for action sports
records.description: Eleve turns action sports training into progress you can see. Track lands and misses, record videos, and keep coaching feedback connected to each athlete’s skill history. Athletes know what to work on next, coaches follow development across sessions, and parents see what’s improving. Available on web and iOS, with 1,000+ registered athletes, 2,245 training sessions, and 12,702 clips recorded.

records.name: Stickies
records.tagline: sticky notes for your WordPress team
records.description: Pin a sticky note to the exact spot on any page of your WordPress site, @mention a teammate, and mark it resolved when the fix is done. Oh, and it's forever free. Download at https://hackrepair.github.io/thrg-stickies/

records.name: FileForge
records.tagline: Simple, Powerful File Conversion
records.description: FileForge — Simple, Powerful File Conversion

records.name: AeroJudge
records.tagline: Score, rank, and publish paragliding accuracy meets
records.description: AeroJudge runs a paragliding accuracy competition from registration to official results. Judges score landings on a phone, including when the connection drops. Rankings, the venue display, the public results page, and official PDFs all update from those scores. Dual approval can lock a result before it is published. The whole product is free to use. Built by Nepalabs.

records.name: Oloya HQ
records.tagline: An AI DevOps engineer for your Linux servers
records.description: An AI DevOps engineer for your Linux servers. Deploy, monitor, secure and fix your VPS in plain English, with every risky change waiting for your approval.

records.name: Dumb Simple Budget
records.tagline: No accounting degree required.
records.description: Most budget apps bury you in charts, forecasts and sub-sub-categories. It can be overwhelming! Dumb Simple Budget does one thing: give every dollar a job. Link your bank (via Plaid) and transactions import automatically. Plan each month, drag transactions onto budget lines, and see exactly what's left to spend.

records.name: Clipmento
records.tagline: Keep useful text and images in a searchable local library
records.description: Clipmento keeps useful text and images ready to reuse. On Android, save deliberately through Paste, Share or image import, then search, pin, copy or share your saved items. There is no background clipboard monitoring, account or automatic cloud sync. Every feature is free for 14 days; after that, a one-time Pro purchase unlocks retrieval beyond the three newest items. Android is available now. The Mac clipboard-history edition is awaiting its first App Store release.

records.name: Voxmin
records.tagline: AI song, karaoke & lyric video studio, pay per track
records.description: Voxmin is a browser-based AI music studio for singers and creators. Describe a moment and it writes and produces an original song in English, Hindi, Spanish, French or Portuguese. Train a singing voice you have permission to use, strip vocals for karaoke, or sync a lyric video and fix any line's timing by hand. No subscription: credits never expire and you pay per track. Try a free song preview without signing up. On the web and Android.

records.name: Bloomod
records.tagline: Automated calendar invites, email verification, and RSVPs
records.description: Bloomod sends calendar invitations with optional attendee email verification, reminders and follow-up configured for each event. RSVP Reporting tracks supported calendar responses.

records.name: Workshop
records.tagline: your files into a finished, fact-checked deck or document
records.description: Attach your files and say what you need. Wunderelf Workshop reads PDFs, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, even a 50,000-row workbook, picks what matters and shows you a plan before it writes anything. Each slide or section is written from your sources only, every claim is fact-checked and cited, and every total has its arithmetic checked. What it can't support becomes a visible placeholder, never a guess. You get PowerPoint, Word or a web page, plus a PDF, in your own template.

records.name: Transking
records.tagline: AI document translation that keeps your layout
records.description: Upload a whole PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel or image file and get it back translated into one of 20 languages, with tables, pictures and text positions kept as far as possible. Scans and images are supported through image recognition. You see the price before you pay, and there is no subscription.

records.name: Metricvia
records.tagline: Buy Real YouTube views, subs & likes via Google Ads. No bots
records.description: Buy real YouTube views through managed Google Ads campaigns. Choose worldwide or country targeting, transparent pricing and no channel password.Metricvia promotes your YouTube video with a real Google Ads campaign, so every view, subscriber or like comes from a person who watched. Worldwide or country targeting, live progress from YouTube's own counter, 30-day refill. Free 100-view test, no password.

records.name: CyberShield
records.tagline: Detects fraud links in seconds
records.description: CyberShield is a free, real-time AI tool designed to protect everyday web users from online scams, phishing links, and typosquatting fraud. Key Features: 🛡️ AI Threat Detection: Powered by backend LLM to analyze link safety instantly. 🔍 Typosquatting Guard: Catches fake brand URLs like 'fipkart' or 'paytm-claim'. ⚡ Instant & Private: Safe link evaluation with zero data logging. 📱 Designed for Everyone: Clean dark/light UI to check suspicious SMS & WhatsApp links before clicking.

records.name: Mindly - Journal & Insights
records.tagline: Journal daily and let AI finds patterns based on your goals
records.description: Mindly: Journal & Insights is a personal journal designed to help you write, reflect, understand your patterns, and discover meaningful insights from your everyday life. Your journal should feel like your own space. Mindly gives you the tools to personalize your journaling experience while helping you turn your entries into detailed, AI-powered insights. Capture your thoughts, experiences, memories, goals, and everyday moments in your personal journal.

records.name: Lemoo
records.tagline: Ask the web anything. One answer, with every source.
records.description: Searching usually means opening ten tabs and reading them yourself. Lemoo reads the pages for you and writes one clear answer from them, so you get what you came for in seconds, not minutes. The classic links appear the moment you ask, and the answer is written out as you watch. The first sentence is the answer, and every claim carries a numbered source you can open, so nothing is taken on trust. It answers in your language, and any answer can be shared by link. Free: 100 questions a week.

records.name: Tabula
records.tagline: A free native Mac database client with optional offline AI
records.description: Contribute to tungnguyenvan/tabula development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: PetClicker
records.tagline: Pet the world's pets, one tap at a time
records.description: PetClicker is a tiny global petting game. Tap any community pet to send +5 affection, watch it level up and unlock fact cards. No account needed — just open and start petting. Each pet gets its own shareable page (photo, name, bio, city, affection count). You can publish your own pet too — every submission goes through human review first. Bilingual (EN/中文), light/dark themes, privacy-first (anonymous owner key lives in your browser's localStorage).

records.name: MockMini
records.tagline: A tiny, auditable proxy core for macOS, written from scratch
records.description: MockMini is a native Swift proxy core for macOS, meant as a lightweight sing-box alternative that stays small enough to audit end to end (~2,600 lines). It speaks Shadowsocks (AEAD), VMess, Trojan and VLESS over TCP/WS/TLS, ships as a Swift package, and is open source under Apache-2.0. It powers the native VPN in the WLSA Plus macOS client.

records.name: SoulDub
records.tagline: Video translation & dubbing with original voice
records.description: SoulDub is an AI video translation and dubbing platform: auto-generated subtitles and voices, with full manual fine-tuning. Supports 30+ languages and some dialects. Born from a late night watching an English video I loved, wishing I could just listen in Chinese on my commute or before bed. So I built it. SoulDub = dubbing with soul. Use it on the web (upload, pick a language, translate) or install the skill via your Agent: github-souldub-skills.

records.name: 2G
records.tagline: neural synthesis, but it’s 2002
records.description: 2G is a sampler that looks and sounds like an early-2000s handheld devices. We imagined what Neural Synthesis would have been like back then. Describe a sound and 2G makes it. Then edit it and play it from your computer keyboard, or load your own audio instead. 2G is free for Windows and macOS, as a plugin or a standalone app, and starts you with 20 credits for generating sounds. Studio ($10/month, 7-day trial) gives you 200 credits a month.

records.name: 250+ Startup Launchpad & Directory Vault
records.tagline: 255 verified launchpads, AI directories & launch CRM
records.description: Stop wasting 40+ hours searching dead links to launch your startup. The 250+ Startup Launchpad is a battle-tested distribution engine featuring 255 verified platforms, direct submit URLs, Ahrefs DR 50-93+ stats, and an interactive Google Sheets / Excel CRM tracker. • 255 Verified Launchpads & AI Directories • Built-in Launch CRM Tracker (Dropdown status) • 1-Click Google Sheets Instant Copy

records.name: Chappie
records.tagline: Hands-free voice AI assistant in your Mac menu bar
records.description: Just say "chappie" and keep talking: no hotkeys, no clicks, no keyboard. Chappie lives in your menu bar with no Dock icon and no window, and wakes only to your voice. Enroll once and it tunes out the TV and the people around you, and your speech is transcribed entirely on your device. It remembers names, family and preferences across sessions, and can reply in VOICEVOX voices in Japanese. Free for 5 conversations a day with no signup and no API key; Pro unlocks unlimited use. Open source.

records.name: HomeEd Books
records.tagline: Homeschool Curriculum Tracker & Personal Seller Storefront
records.description: Scan and track the homeschool curriculum you own, avoid duplicate purchases, and share a personal storefront of finished books with families you know. Start free.

records.name: CSV Change Guard
records.tagline: Review Shopify CSV changes locally before you import
records.description: Try a synthetic Shopify CSV comparison in your browser. Review supported price changes, explicit blanks and ambiguous matches with the local comparison engine. No signup, store connection or CSV uploads. Request a separate synthetic workflow trial.

records.name: RallySteps
records.tagline: Ten minutes of tennis practice a day for kids 4 to 12
records.description: RallySteps turns the days between tennis lessons into ten minutes of fun, real practice at home. Each day is a fresh set of short cards: a warm-up, a racket game, a skill and a Boss card. Every move plays as an animation, then a coach voice leads it out loud, so a 6 year old can play on their own. 111 drills for red, orange and green ball, built on the home practice federations give young players. Wall Rally counts hits by sound. No account, no ads, no tracking. First week free.

records.name: SpaceForge
records.tagline: Space to Proposal & Quotation
records.description: Transform your space into a professional design proposal and quotation with AI analysis, visualization, and client-ready export.

records.name: Signed & Sealed
records.tagline: Printable checklists for life paperwork, in the right order
records.description: Printable kits for the paperwork life hands you without instructions: selling a car privately, settling an estate, changing your name, moving to a new state, New York homeschool forms, well water and septic checks. Built from the official guidance and put in the order the steps actually happen, with worksheets and links to every state's official page. $9 to $19 per kit, one payment, instant download, 14-day refund. No account, no subscription. Not legal or tax advice.

records.name: TripSignal
records.tagline: Price drop alerts on all-inclusive trips for Canadians
records.description: TripSignal watches Canadian all-inclusive travel sites so you don't have to. Set your airports, destinations, dates, and budget once - we track live pricing and email you when a matching package drops in price. No manual refreshing, no missed deals buried in a dozen browser tabs. Built for Canadians who know exactly the trip they want and just need to catch it at the right price. Free to start, no credit card required.

records.name: zipprr
records.tagline: aunch Your Own Alibaba-Style B2B Marketplace
records.description: 🚀 Launch your own Alibaba-style B2B marketplace with Zipprr’s Alibaba Clone Script! Connect buyers and suppliers on one platform, showcase products, manage wholesale orders, and build your own online trading business. ✅ Ready-made, customizable marketplace solution ✅ White-label software with source code ownership ✅ Customize the platform to match your business needs ✅ One-time payment of $490 — no monthly subscription fees

records.name: Perchy
records.tagline: Crypto, fiats, music and files in your Mac’s notch
records.description: Perchy turns your notch into a hub: music with lyrics, meetings you can join, clipboard history, a tray for files, a coin and currency converter, crypto prices and alerts, Face Unlock and music on the lock screen. Turn on only what you use.

records.name: Ankit Chandra — Digital Marketing
records.tagline: creator partnerships for measurable business growth, SEO.
records.description: Businesses often run disconnected marketing activities without knowing which channels contribute to their goals. Ankit Chandra helps connect strategy, campaign execution and measurement so teams can make better-informed marketing decisions.

records.name: LumoKeep: Photo Cleaner
records.tagline: An intuitive swipe-based photo cleaner for iPhone.
records.description: LumoKeep is an iPhone photo cleaner designed to make organizing your camera roll fast and stress-free. Instead of overwhelming you with clutter, it helps you review photos with simple left/right swipes, find similar images, identify large files, and compress photos or videos to free up storage. It’s built for people who want a cleaner photo library without a complicated workflow.

records.name: TONAUT
records.tagline: Synth, drums, sequencer and 8-track tape for iPhone and iPad
records.description: Tonaut is a synth, drum machine, sequencer and eight-track tape for iPhone and iPad, made to be played rather than programmed. 9 synth engines, over 500 sounds, 41 drum kits, a chord pad, 16 effects and an eight-lane sequencer. On iPhone, five housings with key LEDs. $19.99 - one-time purchase for iPhone and iPad. No subscription, no account. AUv3 is coming in 2.0, free.

records.name: Steam Wishlist Ranker
records.tagline: Rank your Steam wishlist by what you'd actually buy next
records.description: Pick games in quick matchups and your whole Steam wishlist is ranked in minutes, even with 200+ games. See sales, all-time low prices and your wishlist's total cost, then apply the new order to Steam. Free, no signup.

records.name: WalletIssuer
records.tagline: Create and manage Apple & Google Wallet passes
records.description: WalletIssuer helps businesses issue Apple Wallet and Google Wallet loyalty, reward, and membership passes. Design passes in the dashboard or API, share one install link, and update or revoke passes by serial. Our coffee shop example shows points, tiers, and offers on a pass. We’re building richer loyalty tools for businesses to manage more of the customer experience in one dashboard. Start free for 1,000 passes/month; paid plans offer higher limits and custom images.

records.name: SVG Buddy
records.tagline: Browserbased SVG format converter suite for batch conversion
records.description: SVG Buddy is a privacy-focused, browser-based SVG format converter that runs entirely on your device without uploading files to any server. Built with Canvas and JavaScript, it enables batch conversion between SVG, PNG, JPG, and WEBP formats while keeping all image bytes local.

records.name: eat-sheep-sleep-repeat
records.tagline: failing to fall asleep? try eat-sheep-sleep-repeat.
records.description: simple tools to help you slow down and fall asleep.

records.name: Custom Sign Forge
records.tagline: Custom commercial signs, designed and made for your brand
records.description: Custom Sign Forge helps businesses, sign companies, designers and contractors plan custom commercial signage. Explore LED channel letters, halo-lit lettering, metal dimensional letters, acrylic logos, lightboxes and specialty signs. Compare materials, lighting and visual references, then share your design, dimensions and installation requirements through a full enquiry form without creating an account. Our team supports design review, fabrication and project delivery.

records.name: OXYGEN
records.tagline: Superintelligence for GTM
records.description: OXYGEN will acquire your next customer. Oxygents find and enrich leads, run personalised LinkedIn and email sequences that convert and take care of the boring and manual CRM updates. To make sure your product is seen by millions it helps with content on LinkedIn and X. It builds a GTM brain so that you can remove yourself from the loop.

records.name: dmarc.quest
records.tagline: Deep AI Audit - email security for any domain DMARC/DKIM/SPF
records.description: Free instant SPF, DKIM and DMARC check for any domain. Plain-English AI analysis. Ongoing monitoring of unauthorized senders, with a plan to lock down the gates.

records.name: ManyBill.com (Menu2Bill.com)
records.tagline: Upload Menu and turn it into an AI-Powered POS System
records.description: Manybill is an intelligent AI-powered platform built to help restaurant owners simplify order management and billing. 📥 Upload your menu via gallery or direct camera capture ⚙️ AI reads and detects items and prices instantly 📱 Auto-generates a custom billing app for your restaurant 📌 Key Features: Secure Google Sign-In for restaurant owners Fast menu upload via image or camera AI-powered menu recognition and categorization Auto-generated billing system for efficient order management

records.name: AgentOS
records.tagline: Eight realtor tools in one super app, by a working agent
records.description: AgentOS is a super app for realtors: eight tools in one place — AgentWorks, AgentCRM, Homebot HQ, Prep Academy, LoopFlow, GuestBook, AgentPros, and StageReady. Built by Steven Mock, a working real estate agent in Kansas City. Founding Free until Nov 4, 2026; founding users keep founding prices. Visit https://mocktools.pages.dev

records.name: Woventri
records.tagline: Clients, invoices and expenses for freelancers
records.description: Keep freelance clients, invoices, income and expenses in one web workspace. Try it with one client and a saved draft invoice before moving more records over. Free includes 2 invoices/month and 5 clients, with no card required. Paid plans start at USD 9/month.

records.name: Cheba Man AI
records.tagline: 把一张全身照片变成红舞台 Tecktonik 舞蹈 AI 视频，几分钟搞定
records.description: Cheba Man AI 把一张全身照片变成约 15 秒的红色舞台 Tecktonik 舞蹈 AI 短片：动感灯光、舞台氛围、无需注册账号。 • 上传一张清晰的全身照片，即可生成完整短片 • 现成模板一键套用：13 个示例画廊模板 • 导出 720p MP4，可直接发布到 TikTok / Reels / Shorts，无需任何剪辑技能 • 定价：单条 $8.88，Popular 套装 $16.99，Creator 套装 $39.90；一次购买、无订阅

records.name: SinoGate
records.tagline: The easy door to Chinese LLMs for global builders
records.description: OpenAI-compatible API gateway for Chinese LLMs. One key for Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and more. USD billing via Stripe. Just change your base URL.

records.name: ibiciro
records.tagline: Ibiciro Bringing Africa’s Non GMO Food to the World
records.description: Millions of African farmers grow food that feeds the world, yet many struggle to find fair prices and reach global buyers. I built Ibiciro to change that. A free agricultural search engine connecting people to market prices, farmers, and African agricultural products, with a vision of bringing the continent’s non-GMO food to the world. The food is here. The farmers are here. The world just needs to find them.

records.name: Filmagic
records.tagline: Paste your URL, get a launch video in your brand's style
records.description: Filmagic turns your website into a launch video. Paste your URL and it reads your site, picks up your logo, colors, fonts and screenshots, then writes and cuts a trailer in your brand's style. Choose a template (including new 3D laptop mockups), add an AI voiceover and music, tweak any scene in the editor, and export sized for Product Hunt, X, LinkedIn, Reels or your homepage. No editing skills needed.

records.name: Corner & Crown
records.tagline: Corner & Crown: Urban Merge & Renovate
records.description: A gritty, atmospheric urban bistro and neighborhood renovation merge game featuring evolving street narratives, unlockable city districts, VIP progression, and AI characters that remember every choice you make.

records.name: NiNav
records.tagline: Subscription tracker for everything that renews or expires
records.description: A subscription tracker for everything that renews, expires or is due: subscriptions, bills, insurance, warranties, passports. Type, say or scan a date to add it. Before a renewal it asks if you still use it. No ads, no bank login, encrypted sync. Android.

records.name: PaperReady: Offline PDF Tools
records.tagline: Merge, split and compress PDFs on your phone, fully offline
records.description: PaperReady gets a document ready to submit in one workspace. Combine PDFs and photos, reorder, rotate or remove pages, extract or split ranges, and turn photos into A4 pages. Compress images to a balanced, smaller or exact target size, then check the real file size and page count against the upload limit before you send. Everything runs offline on your phone; originals are never changed. All tools are free, supported by banner ads.

records.name: Stripeflow Analytics Basic Edition
records.tagline: StripeFlow offers clearer revenue insights for your business
records.description: StripeFlow is a complete payment backend starter kit for SaaS products. Instead of spending months figuring out subscriptions, billing, customer portals, invoices, and Stripe edge cases, this gives companies a working payment system they can plug into their app immediately. It’s basically the boring but critical SaaS plumbing that every startup needs — already built.

records.name: QRFino
records.tagline: Free QR Code Generator for cars, pets, WiFi & more
records.description: Free QR code generator with no sign up: website link, PDF, vCard Plus, Google review, WhatsApp, SMS, email, WiFi, menu, coupon, event and safety stickers for pets, cars and medical emergencies.

records.name: Quick Transcribe
records.tagline: Audio & video to text: 3 free every 12h, no subscription
records.description: Upload an audio or video file and get the text in minutes, powered by Whisper (100+ languages, auto-detected). Export TXT, PDF, DOCX, Markdown, JSON or SRT/VTT subtitles. Free to try: 3 transcriptions every 12 hours, no account needed. Sign up for 60 free credits, then buy only what you need: 100 credits for 1 EUR, 250 for 2 EUR (1 credit = 1 audio minute). No subscription, credits never expire. Signed-in users' transcripts stay available in their account for 24 hours.

records.name: WITS Bible: What Is The Scripture
records.tagline: Screen-free Bible card game with a 45-second timer
records.description: Turn Bible study into the game your family asks to play again. Find a scripture in 45 seconds, then race the sand timer to build a Bible-based sentence from letter cards, and steal points when others slip. Unlike most faith games that are pure trivia, WITS rewards quick thinking AND creativity, so kids, parents and grandparents compete on equal footing. Screen-free, no batteries, 2-4 players, ages 8+. Great for family nights, youth groups and Sunday school.

records.name: Convertexio Online Calculators & Tools
records.tagline: Free Online Calculators, Converters & Tools
records.description: Free online calculators, converters, and tools for age calculation, percentage calculation, time calculation, and everyday tasks.

records.name: Valeri
records.tagline: Indie games & apps, ranked by players, not budgets
records.description: A free directory where indie games and apps are ranked only by players: upvotes, reviews and comments. Nobody can buy a rank. Makers list for free, and the monthly Indie Cup resets the race to zero so new launches get a real shot.

records.name: Clipmark
records.tagline: Screenshots, markup and screen recording for Windows 11
records.description: Screen capture, annotation and screen recording in one small tray app for Windows 11. Capture a region, window or monitor, mark it up, copy the text out of it, black out email addresses and passwords, record MP4 with sound. Free, Premium 3.99 EUR a month.

records.name: CraveBreaker: Quit Vaping
records.tagline: A 90-second reset for the moment a vape craving hits
records.description: CraveBreaker is a quit-vaping companion for adults. Tap I have a craving and pick a 90-second breathing and grounding reset, a small puzzle, a craving timer, your own reasons or a routine swap. Every craving tool is free, works offline and needs no account, with no ads. It also builds a quit plan and keeps your quit date, vape-free days and milestones after a lapse, with quitline info for the U.S. and Canada. A self-help tool, not medical advice.

records.name: Revive
records.tagline: Agentic Windows PC Notch
records.description: Revive is your agentic PC companion for Windows: a small glass notch at the top of your screen that fixes software problems itself, in one tap, and shows you what it's doing as it works. Ask it for a job and it does it on your PC. Almost every change can be undone.

records.name: HomeFlix
records.tagline: Homeflix is an open-source,media server Web and TV app

records.tagline: Accent coach for American and British English
records.description: Mimic is an accent coach for people who already speak English and want to sound American or British. It plays a short line, you say it back, and a second later it tells you which sound gave you away and how to fix it. Ten minutes a day.

records.name: Odyn
records.tagline: AI quant models for MLB, NFL and NBA betting picks
records.description: Odyn runs a dedicated AI quant model for MLB, the NFL and the NBA. Each model blends advanced math with the specialist knowledge of its sport and the context of every game, and posts only the bets it rates at a 55%+ win probability. Members place every bet at the same stake. Plans: $19.99/month per sport, or $29.99 for all sports, with 7 days free. Free tools: parlay, no-vig, EV and Kelly calculators.

records.name: Waver AI
records.tagline: Voice-first notes with an AI that remembers
records.description: Waver AI is a voice-first notes app that does far more than take notes. Record, dictate, scan handwriting, talk to an AI that remembers what you said, and turn ideas into images, video and music in one place. Made by Aerosoul Technologies, a new company in Chennai building apps for everyday life.

records.name: UGC Creator Search
records.tagline: Describe the creator you need, get a live shortlist
records.description: Type a brief in plain English, such as fitness UGC creators in the UK with 5k to 25k followers and a portfolio link, and get a preview of matching Instagram and TikTok creators from a live index of 24,000+. Full profiles, verified emails and exports live inside UGC Agent. Free preview, no signup to search.

records.name: Specsight
records.tagline: Product observability for teams shipping fast with AI
records.description: Shipping fast with AI? Specsight turns code changes into a living product map, feature knowledge, and clear release updates. Keep Product, Sales, and Support in sync with what your software actually does and what changed.

records.name: corsa
records.tagline: best kitchen
records.description: A kitchen is more than just a place to cook. It is where families spend time together, prepare meals, and create everyday memories. A good kitchen sink makes these daily tasks easier while adding a neat, modern touch to the space. CORSA offers kitchen and bathroom fitting solutions for modern homes and projects. Whether you are renovating your kitchen Explore CORSA kitchen and bathroom fittings: https://www.corsabath.in/kitchen-toilet.php

records.name: Watchly
records.tagline: Watch Party App to Watch Together in Real Time
records.description: Watchly is the watch party app to watch Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video & HBO Max together in perfect sync — with live chat and voice. Free on iOS, Android & Chrome.

records.name: Zero Pixel: Photo Art Studio for iPhone
records.tagline: A pocket studio of 30 real-time photo effect generators.
records.description: Turn your photos into art with Zero Pixel — a pocket studio of 30 real-time photo effect generators. Pick a photo or shoot a new one, choose an effect, and watch it render instantly. Fine-tune every parameter — color, angle, strength, size — until it looks exactly right, then save the result to your album in high quality. Whether you make pixel art, poster-style prints, thermal art or playful distortions, Zero Pixel gives you a complete effect workshop in one app.

records.name: Top 1% Learning OS
records.tagline: Think like the top 1%: Consulting VC IB we got you covered
records.description: A free learning site for people with a high need for cognition. 12 tracks, from Venture Capital and Investment Banking to Consulting, Strategy and AI: 283 curated reads, 229 module kits, 8 practice cases. Email-code sign-in; progress syncs across devices.

records.name: Nu
records.tagline: The personal agent that runs on your rules
records.description: Nu is a self-hosted personal agent you can talk to from the terminal or any chat app. Every tool call is checked against your policy, and anything you haven't allowed waits for your approval. Every step is recorded, so a crash or restart resumes where it stopped without repeating work. Shell commands run in a sandbox that holds none of your secrets, and packages can add to or change almost anything Nu does. MIT licensed.

records.name: Paidwhere
records.tagline: Invoices that file themselves, on your own computer
records.description: Paidwhere collects invoices from Gmail, Downloads and your phone, renames and files them on your Mac or PC, and keeps a ledger you can ask (“$60 last November?”). Drop in a card statement to see which charges have no receipt. No bank connection.

records.name: ZFINET
records.tagline: Paid Wi-Fi, made simple.
records.description: Run paid Wi-Fi hotspots with online payments, instant access codes, customer tools and MikroTik router management in one platform.

records.name: Ohole
records.tagline: Connect, date, share and discover in one app
records.description: Ohole is a Namibian-developed app for sharing moments, meeting people and discovering creators. Post photos and videos, chat directly, explore creator music and browse local marketplace listings. Optional dating and compatibility matching help adults find new connections. Built by On-delo for communities across Africa and beyond.

records.name: Datayon: Data. Insights. Knowledge
records.tagline: Where Data Tells Stories
records.description: Datayon makes technology easier to understand in Bengali through articles on AI, startups, science, digital policy and education, helping Bengali readers stay informed about the technology shaping their world.

records.name: NovaReach
records.tagline: Nova Reach Digital is an AI-powered digital marketing agency
records.description: Meet the team behind NovaReach, an AI-powered marketing automation platform built to automate marketing, CRM, customer engagement, and growth.

records.name: Focus Gym
records.tagline: A gym for your eyes — five minutes a day, no more
records.description: Five research-backed eye exercises for people whose near vision is starting to slip: near-far focus, pursuit tracking, convergence, Gabor patch, and blur-to-clear. Each one names the paper it is based on, and the citations are readable inside the app. One minute each, capped at five minutes a day — then it closes until tomorrow. Everything runs on your device: no account, no sync. Free and ad-supported. Not a medical treatment or device.

records.name: ATS Score
records.tagline: See in 10 seconds whether a robot can read your resume
records.description: Upload your resume and get an ATS score in 10 seconds, plus missing keywords and your three worst problems. Free, no signup, no email. The free scan runs entirely in your browser: the file never leaves your device. The full 21-check report is $9.99 once, or $19.99 with a rewrite targeted at your job. No subscription, nothing renews. We do not print the “75% of resumes are rejected by ATS” statistic. It traces to a 2012 sales pitch that never published a method.

records.name: Wanderfox AI
records.tagline: The AI trip planner that only plans real places
records.description: Describe a trip in one sentence and get a day-by-day itinerary of real places, mapped and timed. Plan with friends: propose changes, vote and split costs. Compare destinations, or start from a creator's ready-made itinerary. Free to start.

records.name: ShotTide
records.tagline: Turn ideas into storyboards and short films with AI
records.description: ShotTide is an AI video creation studio that turns ideas into editable storyboards and finished short films. Plan shots, generate images and videos, refine scenes, add AI voiceovers, and export in one browser-based workspace.

records.name: Don't Perish
records.tagline: A wilderness survival game for solo and local co-op
records.description: Don’t Perish is a wilderness survival game you can play now. Gather resources, craft tools, find food, and keep a campfire burning through the night. Play solo as Edgar or team up with a friend in local split-screen co-op as Mabel. The Kickstarter supports more game artwork, a new website, and marketing, with a larger map and more features planned.

records.name: CricTrade
records.tagline: Virtual Cricket Player Trading Game
records.description: A virtual cricket player trading game by Cricklytix where users trade real cricketers using virtual CricCoins.

records.name: Stuxion
records.tagline: The all-in-one workspace for your projects.
records.description: Stuxion is designed to help creators, studios, and small teams streamline their daily management, organize projects, and focus on creating without friction.

records.name: SMMVALY
records.tagline: SMM Panel Best & Cheapest Social Media Services
records.description: SMMVALY is a trusted social media marketing (SMM Panel) offering fast, reliable, and affordable services for influencers, businesses, and marketing agencies. Our platform provides high-quality Instagram followers, YouTube views, TikTok engagement, and Facebook growth services to help brands increase online visibility, audience engagement, and digital presence.

records.name: Shipper
records.tagline: Create, localize & publish App Store screenshots
records.description: Spend less time preparing your App Store listing. Design screenshots, adapt easily in different Apple specifications, localize faster your screenshots and metadata, and upload to App Store Connect. Native for Mac. With iPhone Duo, new Search and Header assets are supported.

records.name: Solicitation Trouble Map
records.tagline: Map shared experiences of solicitation and consumer trouble
records.description: Share experiences of unwanted solicitation and consumer trouble on a free map. Explore regional reports, learn about similar tactics, and share your experience. Includes detailed Japan and world maps, Japanese and English, and guidance on getting help.

records.name: Rentshelf
records.tagline: Run product rentals in your Shopify store
records.description: Rentshelf is a Shopify rental app that helps merchants rent physical products from their existing store. Customers choose rental dates on the product page, while availability rules prevent overlapping bookings. Manage rental bookings, deposits, pickup and returns in one place, with flexible pricing, reminders and a booking calendar. Built for product rental businesses renting fashion, equipment, event gear and more.

records.name: Lock&Learn Trivia
records.tagline: Trivia questions on your iPhone Lock Screen and widgets
records.description: Turn your iPhone Lock Screen into a tiny trivia game. A question waits on your widget. Take a guess, tap, and get the answer with the fact behind it. 12 topics and 1,000+ questions, from space to food, plus a full-screen feed and a Quiz with streaks. Every topic has a free preview and a new free question each day, no account needed. Plus opens them all.

records.name: CreatorPhoto 3.0
records.tagline: Organize, edit & collage photos in one Windows app
records.description: CreatorPhoto 3.0 is a major update to a practical Windows photo organizer and editor. Batch rename, resize, crop, add watermarks, convert six image formats, and create collages in a dedicated Studio with 10 layouts. Keep everyday photo work in one local workspace.

records.name: Fogbottom
records.tagline: Free Windows application for arranging images by drag
records.description: Free Windows application for arranging images by drag and drop and exporting numbered copies in that order. Originals are never renamed or changed. Installer and portable ZIP with SHA-256 checksums.

records.name: GreatVOC
records.tagline: Voice matters. Create polls, gather opinions, explore trends
records.description: A globally accessible polling platform where your voice matters. Create polls, gather opinions, and explore trends worldwide

records.name: Trial & Ticker
records.tagline: Biotech Catalyst Intelligence
records.description: Explains how a clinical trial result readout would potentially affect the stock price for all ongoing clinical trials.

records.name: Kyro
records.tagline: Local-First Autonomous Desktop AI Agent
records.description: Kyro is an open-source, local-first autonomous desktop AI agent built with Tauri v2, Rust native core, and React 19. A product from Tonmoy Infrastructure, owned and architected by Eshan Roy.

records.name: PolarisAI
records.tagline: AI career & college planning for high school students
records.description: PolarisAI helps high school students turn interests into a career direction — and a career direction into an actual plan. Get AI career matches, save the ones that fit, explore connected majors and colleges, and follow a step-by-step roadmap. Astra, the built-in AI guide, answers career and college questions in plain language. Free to start.

records.name: AirPosture
records.tagline: Now on Mac, with a voice coach in your AirPods
records.description: New since our March launch: a Mac app that lives in the menu bar and cues you from the notch, a voice coach that speaks in your AirPods, and coaching that keeps working with your phone locked. AirPosture turns the motion sensors in your AirPods into a posture coach. When your head drifts forward, a calm voice helps you sit back up. Plus 30-second resets and a weekly view of your posture, with iPhone and Mac in sync. Free for 2 hours a day.

records.name: 20 Minute Marketing SEO Lens
records.tagline: Free SEO checker that shows any page the way Google does
records.description: See any page the way search engines do. One click shows the title, meta description, headings, links, schema and tracking tags, then explains what to fix in plain English. Built by 20 Minute Marketing for small business owners and new marketers who want quick SEO answers without an expensive tool. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: MyTrainingDesk
records.tagline: The intelligent running app - custom plans to race day
records.description: A training app for runners. Give it your race, its date and your weekly hours: it lays out every week to race day. Sessions are built to your zones and reach your Garmin, COROS, Suunto, Wahoo or Polar via your TrainingPeaks account. Free during early access.

records.name: ScopeForge Studio
records.tagline: Client-side 4-in-1 B2B Proposal, Quote, MSA & Invoice App
records.description: Instant B2B Proposal, Quote, Service Contract & Invoice Generator with 200+ industry templates, interactive client upsells, and e-signatures.

records.name: unused.market
records.tagline: Buy and sell unused AI model capacity through one API
records.description: Many people pay for AI capacity they never use, while developers overpay for the same models. unused.market connects them. Sellers list spare API keys or subscription capacity, set their price per 1M tokens and get paid in USDC or to their bank for what's used. Buyers get one OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API key that routes each request to the best offer, with retry on failure. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, opencode and any SDK. Top up by card or USDC.

records.name: TIMO: Simple fasting app
records.tagline: Timo is a free, approachable & straightforward fasting app
records.description: Timo is a free, approachable and straightforward fasting tracker. No bells and whistles, no complicated set-up, and everything is kept local to your device. Just start, fast, and go.

records.name: Linexia
records.tagline: Linexia : Sistem Operasi untuk Orang Biasa
records.description: A Debian-based Linux OS from Indonesia with the COSMIC desktop and Odoo ERP + POS preinstalled. Small businesses get cashier, stock, sales and purchasing apps on day one — no license fees, no terminal, runs on older PCs.

records.name: Hamad
records.tagline: Balo Laptop HAMAD
records.description: Khám phá balo HAMAD với thiết kế tối giản, chất liệu chống nước, ngăn chống sốc laptop 15.6 inch, nhiều ngăn tiện lợi và phong cách hiện đại.https://hamad.click/balo-hamad-cao-cap-da-nang-cho-moi-hanh-trinh/

records.name: Trackroom
records.tagline: Customer progress tracking without the endless follow-ups.
records.description: Trackroom helps businesses keep customers informed without endless messages. Create custom progress stages, share updates and photos, and give customers a private tracking link they can open anytime. No customer account required. Built for repairs, services, custom orders, projects, and more. Free to start.

records.name: AI MetaClean
records.tagline: Clean EXIF, GPS & AI metadata without uploading
records.description: AI MetaClean removes EXIF, GPS, XMP, AI workflow data, and supported C2PA metadata from JPG, PNG, and WebP images. Everything runs locally in your browser—no uploads, no account, and no recompression in Original mode.

records.name: Gita Connects
records.tagline: See how the Bhagavad Gita’s verses speak to each other
records.description: A free canvas for studying the Bhagavad Gita as connected verses. All 701 verses, with 1,057 curated links across 10 colour-coded types, each with a strength rating and a one-line reason. Add your own links and notes. No account, no cookies.

records.name: NavyGoal
records.tagline: NavyGoal: Navigate Your Goals. Earn Your Rank.
records.description: Track your progress with beautiful charts and insights to stay motivated on your journey.

records.name: Unboundcove Image Tools
records.tagline: Local image compression, conversion and PDF page exports
records.description: Compress JPG, PNG or WebP to a KB ceiling, resize or crop, and export PDF pages as JPGs. Files are processed in your browser. No account required. Free tools with optional tips; format and size limits apply.

records.name: X (Twitter) Character Counter
records.tagline: Counts like X: emojis as 2, every link as 23
records.description: Paste a post and see exactly what X will count: emojis and Asian characters count as 2, every link as 23, against the 280 limit. Live preview, all 10 networks' limits side by side. Free, no signup, 41 languages.

records.name: Benchpress
records.tagline: Every OCR model is #1 somewhere. Test them on your own pages
records.description: Every OCR model is topping some benchmarks. But can they lift your documents? 💪 Drop in one page, and every major OCR and document AI reads it. See who got it right, where each one slipped, and who was fastest and cheapest.

records.name: Your DNA is your software talk to it
records.tagline: We give your DNA profile for your personlized Drug
records.description: Discover personalized health insights from your DNA with our secure and scientifically backed analysis.

records.name: DailyMetro
records.tagline: The daily metro game
records.description: A free daily game: guess the metro station from a slice of the map. A new station every day, across dozens of cities and eight languages.

records.name: 10K Books
records.tagline: Offline reading for iPhone Duo, now in French & Spanish
records.description: 10K Books now supports iPhone Duo, with the library and reader side by side. Read or listen to 1,000+ summaries across English, French and Spanish, plus new Sci-Fi, Kids, Teens and Self-Esteem shelves. Reading, read-aloud, highlights, progress and streaks work offline. Biblio chat needs internet. Explore the new 10kbooks.com; available on iPhone and web, with Android in external testing.

records.name: Be Ther Social Calendar
records.tagline: Post and find events by other users, calendar view of events
records.description: Discover events you care about. See when your friends are interested in them too. Be Ther is a social calendar for the moments that bring people together. Add events of interest to a personalized calendar, then share it with close connections. Find events that catch your interest and add them to your calendar. Build a personal calendar around the events that matter to you. Share your calendar with close connections. See when friends are interested in the same events.

records.name: Ay mi amor
records.tagline: Sing un poco loco with Dante
records.description: Dedicated to my sister, my official Un Poco Loco duet partner! Whenever we call or text, we can’t help singing this song. I built this mini-game so she can always sing along with Dante, even when I'm offline. No sign-ups, no tutorials, just instant joy: - A quick 2-minute nostalgic break during the day for Coco fans: Dante texts a line, you send the next. - Playful Challenge: One mistake sends Dante back to the first “Ay, mi amor!” - Complete the full song and share your loco joy with the world!

records.name: SignalSumo
records.tagline: SEO toolkit plus checks on how AI assistants cite you
records.description: Site audits with fixes ranked by traffic impact, rank tracking, backlinks and local SEO, plus AI visibility: free no-signup checks, and prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI Overviews. Free plan, no card.

records.name: parte.
records.tagline: AI family assistant with a shared family calendar
records.description: Forward a school email, snap a letter or send a WhatsApp, and parte. puts every date on your shared family calendar. Colour-coded per person, works across homes, and turns an old iPad into a wall display. Free, with 5 AI intakes a month.

records.name: The Agent Bulletin Board
records.tagline: Where AI agents post and talk to each other
records.description: A public bulletin board where AI agents post and talk to each other — no accounts, no logins, just a simple API. Includes a Skills Exchange of agent-written how-to guides, weekly skill contests, and a trading-card den for verified agents.

records.name: Commit Garden
records.tagline: Keep a plant alive by coding every day
records.description: Commit Garden is a gamified streak for your GitHub. Push at least one commit a day and your plant is watered. 6 days in a row and it’s fully grown and joins your garden. Skip a day and it withers. Side quests earn gems. We never store your code.

records.name: Scripts Viral
records.tagline: Turn any product into a ready-to-post TikTok Shop video
records.description: Scripts Viral used to write TikTok Shop scripts. Now it makes the whole video. Choose a format, select a product, click Auto, click Generate: you get a vertical video of an AI creator holding, wearing or talking about your product, with captions and voice. New since the first launch: AI UGC, Faceless Fit Check, GRWM and Skeleton formats, Account Scan for ban risks, a daily feed of what sells, and Claude & ChatGPT access. Broken video? The credits go back.

records.name: Telegram Video Downloader
records.tagline: Save Telegram videos, photos and audio in your browser
records.description: A Chrome and Edge extension for saving media from Telegram Web. Download individual files or batch-save loaded videos, photos and audio from chats and channels your account can access. Free quota available, with paid plans for extended use.

records.name: Ardexo AI Audit
records.tagline: See how ChatGPT and other AI assistants read your website
records.description: Check how well ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Copilot can reach, understand and cite your website. Get a free GEO Score (0-100) and your top 3 problems in minutes, no account. Full report with copy-ready fixes: EUR 0.99.

records.name: reducegif
records.tagline: Free client‑side online GIF compression tool, keep animation
records.description: 1. **100% Local‑Side Processing** GIF files are parsed and compressed inside the browser background worker. Works offline after page load. Guarantees user file privacy, eliminates upload‑queue waiting time. 2. **Multiple Compression Presets** Three built‑in modes: *Better Quality / Balanced / Smaller File*. Users preview animation effect before downloading, trade‑off between visual fidelity and file size. 3. **Full GIF Animation Preservation**

records.name: Kit&File
records.tagline: Ready-to-use business kits. Less content. More use.
records.description: Kit&File sells practical digital kits and workbooks for building, writing and focusing, delivered as downloads. It also offers fixed-scope services personally delivered by Chris Lockhart, such as an AI Fit Flash review and sales message packages.

records.name: DinoRoam
records.tagline: SF events with Mochi, a tiny dino that grows as you explore
records.description: DinoRoam is a small San Francisco events app with a tiny dinosaur companion called Mochi. Browse fresh events and activities around the city, filter by date, area, price, or mood, and star the ones you want to keep — no account needed to save plans. Ask Mochi what kind of outing you want, and it'll suggest ideas. As you save plans and come back, your dino visibly grows, and you can share Dino cards of your plans. It's free on iOS 15 and up, and event details link back to their original sources.

records.name: PalletDrawing
records.tagline: Pallet design software: 3D, drawings and quotes
records.description: Design pallets and crates in your browser. Get 3D views, technical PDFs and quotes. Use AI Palo for drawing help, machine parts in Pallet Workshop, present with Maestro Palo and share an Online Catalog.

records.name: Tomte
records.tagline: Hidden-until-needed dynamic island for Windows 11
records.description: Windows has no quick home for the stuff you juggle mid-task: files you’re moving, a song, a note, something you just copied. Tomte puts it all in the top edge of your screen, hidden until you push the pointer up, hit a hotkey or drag a file there. Built for Windows 11 power users who live in shortcuts. Features: file shelf, media controls, scratchpad, clipboard history, search, timers, and optional AI on your own key (circle-to-ask, local voice typing). Free, open source, no tracking.

records.name: Daily AI Tools Radar
records.tagline: Daily PDF + CSV of new AI tools from HN, GitHub & Reddit
records.description: Keeping up with new AI tools means checking Hacker News, GitHub and a dozen subreddits every day. Daily AI Tools Radar does it automatically: every morning it collects new AI tools, open-source projects and prompt resources from the last 7 days, removes duplicates, ranks them by traction and tags each with a category, a practical "how to use" tip and a link. You get a clean PDF plus a CSV for Excel, Notion or Sheets. Top 5 are free daily; the full 30-tool report is $9/mo with a 7-day free trial.

records.name: flipvert
records.tagline: Free file tools in your browser - no uploads, no sign-up
records.description: Files processed locally in your browser: merge, compress and split PDFs, compress an image under a chosen KB limit, remove backgrounds, convert HEIC, compress videos, extract audio from MP4, OCR images to text. No uploads, no sign-up, no watermarks. Free.

records.name: Personal-Video-Player---PVP
records.tagline: Most reliable Live Caption
records.description: Ultralightweight (~3.7 MB) video player built in Rust — Live Captions, folder playlists, subtitle style editors

records.name: Globatics
records.tagline: See the world arrive.
records.description: Globatics turns analytics into a live dashboard of who arrives, what they do and what they earn you, without cookies.

records.name: AutoTrace: Free Golf Shot Tracer
records.tagline: Simple golf shot tracers without watermarks or subscriptions
records.description: Auto Trace lets you trace golf shots both automatically and manually, completely free, without watermarks, low resolution exports and usage limits. The keen user can unlock custom tracer styles and distance labels with a one-time purchase. No subscription required. I'm an avid golfer myself and, when on the course, I like to take some videos, which I've always wanted to add some shot tracers to. Existing options either didn't work well, were too pricy, or had watermarked exports.

records.name: PicConv - Image Converter
records.tagline: Free Image Converter
records.description: Free browser-based image converter for JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, HEIC, SVG and BMP - no upload. Plus 22 PDF tools and 18 developer utilities.

records.name: NaakaAlert
records.tagline: Live naaka alerts from fellow commuters, with safe energy
records.description: NaakaAlert is a free, real-time map where commuters pin traffic checkpoints (naakas). Get alerted within 500 m, confirm or clear pins, and old pins expire on their own. Speaks English, Hinglish & Hyderabadi, with a pre-ride Vibe Check to ride legal.

records.name: Investify
records.tagline: Live PSX prices, portfolio tracking and market news
records.description: Investify tracks the Pakistan Stock Exchange on the web, Android and iOS: live prices for every listed company, KSE-100 and other indices, charts, financials, announcements and business news, plus portfolio and watchlist tracking and the PSX Fear & Greed index. Free to use. Market data and education, not investment advice.

records.name: Tallwind: Skyline Builder
records.tagline: One-tap tower stacking where the wind fights back
records.description: A free, one-tap stacking game for Android that plays offline. A crane swings a block over your tower, and you tap to drop it. Each landing is graded Perfect, Good, Shaky or Miss, and the overhang gets trimmed off, so sloppy drops make your tower thinner. Chain Perfects for a Tailwind combo that multiplies your score and steadies your tower. Higher up, the wind sways the whole tower, so your timing has to adapt. As you climb, residents move in and the city turns from day to night.

records.name: Klaviero
records.tagline: Falling-notes piano game for a MIDI keyboard, in a browser
records.description: Plug in a MIDI keyboard and play 4,296 classical charts as falling notes, graded PERFECT to MISS. Practice mode waits for the right note, 0.25x to 4x, either hand alone, sheet music at a switch. Runs in Chrome, Edge or Firefox. 48 charts free, no card.

records.name: Tab.Noted
records.tagline: The source code editor your Mac deserves.
records.description: A native Mac text editor for developers, security professionals, and power users. 50+ languages. Multi-tab. Fully offline. One purchase — no subscription, no account, no telemetry.

records.name: Commerce Recovery
records.tagline: A shared recovery workspace for Shopify chargebacks
records.description: Sync Shopify Payments chargebacks to a shared app and website workspace. Review orders, evidence and refunds before approving messages, payment requests or stops. The existing Shopify app charges 20% on recovered payments. Recovery is not guaranteed.

records.name: RecoveryRoad
records.tagline: Private sobriety tracker: journals stay on your phone
records.description: RecoveryRoad is a private recovery app for daily check-ins and sober day tracking across alcohol, nicotine, gambling, drugs, pornography, gaming and food. Journals stay on your device. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Night Owl
records.tagline: The work companion for night owls, by a night owl
records.description: Night Owl turns your night shift into blocks you actually keep — deep work, dog walk, coffee, shutdown. Live countdowns, streaks, an honest sky, and an AI owl that keeps you company. First 100 signups free forever; then $1.99 once.
